props.name: aria-label

props.description: The curve through the values. "monotone" by default.

props.name: data
props.description: Evenly spaced values. Null leaves a gap. No values, or only nulls, draw nothing and read the dictionary's `noData`.

props.name: data-hover
props.description: "none" leaves hover out: no value shows a crosshair, a dot or a highlight under the pointer. Hover writes a region of about half a kilobyte and five elements per value: a 30-value line is about 18 KB and 150 elements with it and 1.4 KB and 3 elements without, and a 168-value line about 106 KB against 7 KB. Pass "none" where many Sparklines render at once, such as one per row of a long table.

props.name: data-intro
props.description: "none" turns the entrance off. The entrance plays whenever the svg enters the document, so it replays when the element is inserted again: a keyed row that a sort moves, or a panel shown again. Pass "none" where that happens, such as a Sparkline in a sortable table. Reduced motion draws the marks at rest either way.

props.name: format
